# SpectralGeneralizationCriteria

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
Mathematical conditions based on spectral properties of weight matrices that predict generalization in unsupervised Hebbian learning. Provides theoretical guarantees for online learning in neuromorphic hardware, enabling robust in-network adaptation.
